concepts.way: misconception: ++i in the for-update runs before the body each pass
concepts.quote: The update i++ runs first and then the body, so 3 is printed.
concepts.why: The answer says i++ runs before the body, but in a for loop the update runs after each pass of the body, and the code prints 012.
